Brian's passion is to help you achieve greater professional success and enjoy more personal happiness. He does this by teaching you how to ethically move others to action using the science of influence.

feeds.title: Mind Persuasion Blog

It will help you not only to improve your communication skills, goal setting skills, and skills of influence, but will also help you to conquer any internal blocks, such as fear, anxiety, and indecision. The blog is filled with timeless information and helpful strategies to guarantee your success in any endeavor in life.

feeds.title: Persuasive Presentations Blog
feeds.description: Persuasive Presentations is managed by Sharon Ferrier. She consults organizations and individuals who have a need to improve their communication, presentation skills and confidence in public speaking. She believes that passionate people persuade and that to make your message stick, you need to balance information with delivery style. Check out the blog to learn about articles on confidence, persuasion, speaking, presentation skills, power-point, speech writing, and more.

feeds.title: The Science Of Persuasion
feeds.description: In this blog, we discuss everything from concepts and topics within the field of neuromarketing, to other areas of the behavioural sciences that we find fascinating, including all things relevant to neuroscience, behavioural economics, and consumer psychology.
